title: Joint Constraint Aggregation for Qualifier-Sensitive Retrieval-Augmented QA
abstract: arXiv:2610.27114v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented QA can fail even when the correct answer is in the retrieved evidence. This can happen when a competing answer satisfies some, but not all, of the question's requirements and is mentioned frequently in the retrieved documents, which can make it appear to be the best-supported answer. To test whether this retrieval skew actually affects the decision, we manipulate it directly: increasing the prevalence of passages that favor the competing answer makes the model more likely to select it. This points to a decision problem that candidate-level support alone cannot resolve. We therefore introduce Joint Constraint Aggregation (JCA), which compares candidates against the same question-derived requirements using the retrieved evidence. Across three evaluation settings and three instruction-tuned backbones, JCA improves overall accuracy, and its advantage grows when retrieval favors a competing answer. Together, these result

translated_title: 面向限定条件敏感的检索增强问答的联合约束聚合方法
translated_abstract: 检索增强问答即使当正确答案出现在检索到的证据中时也可能失败。这种情况可能发生在：某个竞争性答案只满足问题要求中的一部分（而非全部），却在检索到的文档中被频繁提及，从而使其看起来像是得到最多支持的答案。为了检验这种检索偏斜是否真的会影响模型决策，我们直接对其进行操控：增加偏向竞争性答案的段落的数量，会使模型更倾向于选择该答案。这表明存在一个仅凭候选答案层面的支持度无法解决的决策问题。因此，我们提出了联合约束聚合（JCA），它利用检索到的证据，将候选答案与由问题派生的相同要求进行对比。在三种评估设置和三种指令微调骨干模型上，JCA 提升了整体准确率，并且当检索偏向竞争性答案时，其优势会进一步扩大。这些结果……
tldr: 提出联合约束聚合方法，通过基于检索证据将候选答案与问题派生的统一要求进行联合比对，解决检索增强问答中因检索偏斜导致错误答案被选中的决策问题，并显著提升整体准确率。
en_tdlr: We propose Joint Constraint Aggregation (JCA), which compares answer candidates against the same question-derived requirements using retrieved evidence, resolving decision errors caused by retrieval skew in retrieval-augmented QA and improving overall accuracy.
